 DSEJ Announces Six-Day Pooja Holidays for Schools
 By KL News Network - 4:20 pm October 31, 2026 
 Share 
 WhatsApp Facebook X Telegram Copy URL Email Print 
 SRINAGAR : All government and recognised private schools up to the higher secondary level in Jammu Division will remain closed for Pooja holidays from November 6 to 11, 2026.
 Follow Us On G -N e w s | Whatsapp 
 The Directorate of School Education Jammu (DSEJ) issued the holiday order on October 24, covering educational institutions in both summer and winter zones of the division.
 As per Order No. 357-DSEJ of 2026, issued by the Director of School Education Jammu, the holidays have been declared with reference to Government Order No. 335-Edu of 2005, dated May 13, 2005.
